subject.title: Roadmap: Station profiles for supervised agent workloads and reasoning access

question: Should Crabbox sponsor a Phase 1 generic Station runtime now, while keeping agent-runtime bridging and `modelAccess` out of scope?
rationale: The repository deliberately reserves the API shape without enabling runtime behavior, and implementation requires a human decision that Station should become a first-class core lifecycle primitive before substantial CLI, state, coordinator, and security work begins. citeturn6view0turn12search0

options.title: Sponsor Station Phase 1
options.body: Approve a separate generic SSH-backed Station milestone with durable attempts, supervision, status/logs/stop, TTL and idle handling, and evidence, with no model credentials.

options.title: Keep Roadmap Parked
options.body: Retain the documentation and disabled skeleton but defer runtime work until a stronger consumer, staffing, and ownership plan exists.

options.title: Consolidate Under Agent Runtime
options.body: Move future lifecycle work under https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/530, accepting that a provider-neutral generic Station would no longer be independently sponsored.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Station Phase 1
recommendation.body: Approve a separate generic SSH-backed Station milestone with durable attempts, supervision, status/logs/stop, TTL and idle handling, and evidence, with no model credentials.
